units.source_text: 柏木卫门督缠绵病榻，绝无起色，不觉过了年关。

en.t: Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Gate Guards, lingered on his sickbed with no sign of improvement, and before anyone knew it the year had turned.

units.source_text: 他看了父母悲伤愁叹之状，觉得听天由命地死去，毕竟毫无意义，

en.t: Seeing his parents grieving and sighing in sorrow, he felt that simply yielding to fate and dying would, after all, be meaningless,

units.source_text: 况且背亲先死，罪孽深重。

en.t: and moreover, to die before his parents, turning his back on them, would be a grave sin.

units.source_text: 但继而又想：“我难道还留恋这世间，希望在此贪生么？

en.t: But then he thought again: "Can it be that I still cling to this world and wish to go on living here?

units.source_text: 我自幼怀抱大志，总想做人上人，在公事与私事上建立殊勋。

en.t: From childhood I cherished great ambitions, always hoping to rise above others and achieve outstanding merit in both public and private affairs.

units.source_text: 岂知力不从心，一事无成，遇到一两个实际问题，便见此身毫不中用。

en.t: Yet my strength did not match my wishes, I accomplished nothing, and when faced with one or two real difficulties, I saw that I was utterly useless.

units.source_text: 于是对这世间全然不感兴趣，一心希望出家奉佛，为后世修福。

en.t: So I lost all interest in this world and wished only to leave home, serve the Buddha, and cultivate merit for the life to come.

units.source_text: 又念双亲不乐，乃入山学道之一大羁绊，因此左思右想，因循度日。

en.t: But thinking that my parents would be unhappy became a great obstacle to entering the mountains and pursuing the Way, so I wavered back and forth and let the days pass.

units.source_text: 结果招来莫大痛苦，无颜再见人面。

en.t: In the end I brought immense suffering upon myself and no longer have the face to meet anyone.

units.source_text: 自作自受，谁任其咎？

en.t: I am reaping what I myself have sown; who else could bear the blame?

units.source_text: 过失全从自己心中产生，不能怪怨别人，亦不能向神佛诉恨，

en.t: All fault arose from within my own heart, so I cannot blame anyone else, nor can I complain of resentment to the gods or Buddhas,

units.source_text: 真乃前世注定之事啊！

en.t: it is truly something fixed by a former life!

units.source_text: 谁也没有‘青松千岁寿’，不能永生于世间。

en.t: No one possesses the thousand-year life of the green pine; no one can live forever in this world.

units.source_text: 我不如就在此时死去，倒可赚得世人一点怜悯，

en.t: I would be better off dying now; then I might at least gain a little pity from the world,

units.source_text: 而叫那人对我暂时寄予同情，我便‘殉情不惜身’了。

en.t: and if that person felt even brief sympathy for me, I would have given my life for love without sparing myself.

units.source_text: 如果勉强活在世间，将来势必流传恶名，

en.t: If I force myself to go on living in this world, an evil reputation will surely spread in the future,

units.source_text: 对我自己和对那人，都是很不利的。

en.t: and that would be deeply harmful both to me and to that person.

units.source_text: 与其如此，不如早点死了，可使恨我无礼的人也对我曲予原谅。

en.t: Rather than let that happen, I should die sooner, and even those who hate me for my rudeness may be moved to forgive me somewhat.

units.source_text: 世间万事，一死便尽行消失了。

en.t: All things in the world vanish completely once one dies.

units.source_text: 我除此以外并无过失，源氏大人多年来每逢兴会，

en.t: Apart from this, I have committed no fault, and Lord Genji, for many years whenever there was an elegant gathering,

units.source_text: 必招我入侍，多方爱护，定能原谅我也。”

en.t: always summoned me to attend him and showed me kindness in many ways, so he will surely forgive me."

units.source_text: 他在寂寞无聊之时，常常如此反复寻思，然而越想越觉乏味。

en.t: In lonely and idle moments he often turned these thoughts over and over in his mind, yet the more he thought, the more empty and distasteful everything seemed.

units.source_text: 心情黯然，思绪紊乱，痛惜自身之荒谬，一至于此。

en.t: His heart grew dark, his thoughts fell into confusion, and he grieved bitterly that his own folly had come to such a pass.

units.source_text: 眼泪滚滚流出，枕头几乎浮了起来。

en.t: Tears streamed from his eyes until his pillow almost seemed to float.
